question: Compare the 2025 average completed order value of Enterprise and SMB customers. If Enterprise's is more than 20% higher than SMB's, break down Enterprise's 2025 completed revenue by product category; otherwise, break down SMB's 2025 completed revenue by product category.
plan: The answer depends on a condition: evaluate the condition first with its own query, then answer only the branch that applies.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH enterprise_stats AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise'), smb_stats AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment = 'SMB'), comparison AS (SELECT (SELECT rev * 1.0 / cnt FROM enterprise_stats) AS ent_aov, (SELECT rev * 1.0 / cnt FROM smb_stats) AS smb_aov) SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS completed_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment = CASE WHEN (SELECT ent_aov FROM comparison) > 1.2 * (SELECT smb_aov FROM comparison) THEN 'Enterprise' ELSE 'SMB' END GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY completed_revenue DESC LIMIT 500
